query:
CREATE TABLE `recurring_workflow_history` (
  `id` VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  `recurring_workflow_id` VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  `generated_workflow_id` VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  `scheduled_date` DATE NOT NULL,
  `generated_at` TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `generation_status` ENUM('success', 'failed') NOT NULL,
  `error_message` TEXT,
  `metadata` JSON,
  INDEX `idx_recurring_workflow_id` (`recurring_workflow_id`),
  INDEX `idx_generated_workflow_id` (`generated_workflow_id`),
  INDEX `idx_scheduled_date` (`scheduled_date`)
);
